test_title: PYST 5: SSC MTS 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The price of a mobile is Rs. 30,000. The value of the mobile depreciates by 12% at the end of the first year and at the end of next year, it depreciates by 15%. What will be the value of the mobile after 2 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Price of a mobile = Rs. 30,000. It depreciates by 12% at the end of the first year and 15% at the end of the second year.

**Concept:**

Depreciation is calculated by taking a certain percentage off the value at the start of each year.

**Calculation:**

After the first year, the value = 30,000 × (1 - 12/100) ⇒ Rs. 26,400

After the second year, the value = 26,400 × (1 - 15/100) ⇒ Rs. 22,440

**Hence, the value of the mobile after 2 years is Rs. 22,440. **
